newsitem.title: FRANCE: French fin ministry declines comment on deficit report.
newsitem.headline: French fin ministry declines comment on deficit report.

text.p: The French finance ministry said it had no comment on a newspaper report on Thursday that an audit of public finances would show the 1997 public deficit at 3.6 to 3.7 percent of gross domestic product without corrective action.

Financial daily La Tribune said the audit, due on July 21, would show both the central government budget and social security accounts overshooting targets fixed by the previous government in the 1997 Finance Act.
A finance ministry spokeswoman said she had no comment on the newspaper report.
Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Wednesday the government would announce very quickly after the results of the audit any measures needed to curb the deficit this year.
